label: Migraine
protocol: EDM-MIG-01 v2.3 — Triptans (Part A) & rimegepant / Vydura (Part B, acute only)
notes: Acute on-demand treatment only — not prevention (atogepant / Aquipta excluded).
Continuation-of-treatment service — established doctor-diagnosed migraine required.
Part A (triptans): cardiovascular contraindications apply. Part B (rimegepant): non-vasoconstrictive; different interaction profile.
Service excludes ≥10 migraine days/month (MOH / high-frequency episodic threshold).

ruleGuide.name: Red flags & secondary headache
ruleGuide.summary: Thunderclap headache, new headache >50, focal neurology, atypical aura, meningism, raised ICP pattern, recent head trauma, immunocompromise, progressive/changed headache.

ruleGuide.name: Excluded migraine subtypes
ruleGuide.summary: Hemiplegic, basilar/brainstem, ophthalmoplegic migraine — triptans not indicated.

ruleGuide.name: Pregnancy, breastfeeding & trying to conceive
ruleGuide.summary: Absolute service exclusion for triptans and rimegepant.

ruleGuide.name: Ischaemic heart disease & coronary vasospasm
ruleGuide.summary: MI, angina, IHD, Prinzmetal angina — triptan SmPC absolute contraindication.

ruleGuide.name: Stroke & TIA
ruleGuide.summary: Previous stroke or TIA — triptan class contraindication.

ruleGuide.name: Peripheral vascular disease
ruleGuide.summary: Poor peripheral circulation — triptan service exclusion.

ruleGuide.name: Uncontrolled hypertension
ruleGuide.summary: Moderate/severe or untreated/uncontrolled BP — triptans declined.

ruleGuide.name: Heart failure, arrhythmia & WPW
ruleGuide.summary: HF, significant arrhythmia, Wolff-Parkinson-White — triptan exclusion.

ruleGuide.name: Recent cardiac revascularisation
ruleGuide.summary: CABG, stent, angioplasty within 12 months — service exclusion.

ruleGuide.name: Hepatic impairment
ruleGuide.summary: Moderate/severe liver disease; Child-Pugh C for rimegepant.

ruleGuide.name: Renal impairment
ruleGuide.summary: Any disclosed kidney disease (triptans); severe/ESRD/dialysis (rimegepant).

ruleGuide.name: Epilepsy & seizures
ruleGuide.summary: Epilepsy or seizure history — triptan service exclusion.

ruleGuide.name: Triptan / rimegepant allergy
ruleGuide.summary: Hypersensitivity to sumatriptan, zolmitriptan, rizatriptan, rimegepant or excipients.

ruleGuide.name: Cancer & immunosuppression
ruleGuide.summary: Active/recent malignancy, chemotherapy, immunosuppressants, HIV — red-flag pathway.

ruleGuide.name: Cluster headache features
ruleGuide.summary: Unilateral periorbital autonomic cluster pattern — not migraine; decline.

ruleGuide.name: Giant cell arteritis & occipital headache
ruleGuide.summary: Temporal arteritis, jaw claudication, scalp tenderness, occipital predominant headache.

ruleGuide.name: Combined hormonal contraception with aura
ruleGuide.summary: COC/patch/ring with migraine with aura — UKMEC 4; GP review required.

ruleGuide.name: Ergotamine & ergot derivatives
ruleGuide.summary: Contraindicated with triptans; 24h separation required.

ruleGuide.name: Non-supplied triptans (concomitant use risk)
ruleGuide.summary: Almotriptan, eletriptan, frovatriptan, naratriptan — not supplied; concomitant triptan use contraindicated.

ruleGuide.name: MAOIs
ruleGuide.summary: MAOI or within 2 weeks of stopping — triptan contraindication.

ruleGuide.name: Serotonergic antidepressants & lithium
ruleGuide.summary: SSRIs, SNRIs, other antidepressants, lithium, St John's Wort — service-level decline for triptans.

ruleGuide.name: Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors
ruleGuide.summary: Ketoconazole, itraconazole, clarithromycin, ritonavir, cobicistat — rimegepant contraindicated; triptan precaution.

ruleGuide.name: CYP3A4 inducers
ruleGuide.summary: Rifampicin, carbamazepine, phenytoin — rimegepant efficacy reduced.

ruleGuide.name: CGRP pathway medicines
ruleGuide.summary: Other gepants (atogepant), erenumab, fremanezumab, galcanezumab, eptinezumab — outside combined use scope.

ruleGuide.name: P-gp & moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors (rimegepant)
ruleGuide.summary: Verapamil, erythromycin, ciclosporin, fluconazole taken regularly — rimegepant decline.

ruleGuide.name: Propranolol
ruleGuide.summary: Rizatriptan declined if on propranolol; sumatriptan/zolmitriptan preferred.

ruleGuide.name: CYP1A2 inhibitors
ruleGuide.summary: Cimetidine, fluvoxamine — zolmitriptan declined; dose interaction.

ruleGuide.name: Frequent opioid use
ruleGuide.summary: Opioids for headache — MOH risk; not for acute migraine.

ruleGuide.name: Supplied triptans on SCR (review only)
ruleGuide.summary: Sumatriptan, zolmitriptan, rizatriptan, Imigran, Zomig, Maxalt — expected on continuation; does not fail scan.

ruleGuide.name: Rimegepant / Vydura on SCR (review only)
ruleGuide.summary: Part B product or existing therapy — flagged for context; does not fail scan.

ruleGuide.name: Migraine diagnosis (review only)
ruleGuide.summary: Positive migraine diagnosis terms — supports continuation context; does not fail scan.
